answer: Stored drafts let one writer mint many voting voices. This gate takes a live fourteen-line sonnet stressed from a fresh microphone buffer and pins it to one public loom thread owned by that key. Clerks compute delta = popcount(k12(sonnet||addr||thread_id) XOR a posted meter mask) and admit only if it sits in a 9-bit corridor with no sibling key on that thread. Pinning costs 0.28 POA; 18 POA locks for six epochs. Anyone can rehash the pinned lines against the mask. A corridor miss, reused thread, or pre-written sonnet pays the bond to the first matcher and mutes both keys for thirteen epochs.
